newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 28.

text.p: Kirin Brewery Co Ltd is likely to post a parent current profit of 52 billion yen in the year to December 1996, down 31 percent on last year, due to weak sales.

Procter and Gamble Far East Inc, a Japanese unit of Procter & Gamble Co, plans to set rebate limits on each of its product categories from next January to prevent an overheating of retail competition. It will also ask rival makers to adopt similar systems to establish industry standards on the rebate system.

Toyota will increase production of its Chaser model by about 50 percent to 7,000 to 8,000 units per month, to meet better-than-expected demand. Toyota hopes to gain a 40 percent share of the domestic market in the year to December 1996 by raising output of the car.
